lastCompletedStory.title: CRITICAL: Flaky-test evasion narrative shipped as a durable record. Commit 551e…

openQuestions: CAM-513 (filed on main this story, commit a81006c) tracks isolating the specific test behind the 1-of-8 flaky bun test run recorded on commit 551e5d63. This story could NOT reproduce it: 11 additional consecutive full `bun test --reporter=junit` runs on this checkout all reported 6095 pass / 0 fail with zero code changes between runs. Whoever picks up CAM-513 next should run the suite many more times (junit reporter, grep XML for per-file `failures="N"` with N>0 to avoid the printError()/bun-failure glyph collision documented in patterns.md) to catch and pin the actual test before attempting a root-cause fix.
nextStoryContext: US-R1-003 remediated the CRITICAL finding that commit 551e5d63 ('reconfirm US-001 branch-divergence blocker on 4th dispatch') persisted a flaky-test observation ('1 of 8 consecutive full bun test runs...non-blocking') as a durable scripts/cam/patterns.md bullet without a root-cause fix or a linked follow-up issue -- treating suite non-determinism as an acceptable pass rationale, which the no-flaky-evasion rule forbids regardless of how the story's OWN diff is unaffected. Remedy taken: (1) attempted to reproduce and isolate the specific flaky test by re-running the full suite 11 additional consecutive times with `bun test --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=<path>` (chosen specifically because the patterns.md bullet itself already documented that grepping console output for a leading `✗` glyph is useless here, since this repo's own printError() CLI output renders the identical glyph for passing tests exercising error-message formatting) -- all 11 runs were clean (6095 pass / 0 fail each), so the specific test could not be pinned this session; a true low-frequency flake (~1/8 historically) has a non-trivial chance of not recurring in 11 runs. (2) Filed CAM-513 on main (`cam index.ts issue --file-local`, in-process/no-tmux/no-LLM, safe to run from a feature-branch worktree since it operates on main via git plumbing without checking it out) to track isolating and fixing the root cause on next recurrence, with the repro guidance and the 11-clean-runs result recorded in the issue body. (3) Rewrote the patterns.md bullet (scripts/cam/patterns.md, the `bun test`'s default reporter... bullet) to drop the 'not perfectly stable' / 'non-blocking' framing entirely and instead state plainly that the gap is tracked on CAM-513 and that a single non-deterministic run is a defect, never a pass rationale. Did NOT rewrite or amend commit 551e5d63 itself (git history is immutable per AGENT.md: no rebase/amend/force-push) -- the remedy targets the current, mutable, versioned durable record (patterns.md) and adds the missing linked follow-up issue, which is what a future implementer/reviewer actually reads. No src/ or test/ code changed this story (the underlying flake, if real, is still unisolated and therefore not yet fixable at the root); all quality gates re-verified green on the unchanged codebase: typecheck 0 errors, full bun test 6095 pass / 0 fail (372 files, unchanged from pre-story), full bun run check:all spine green. No vendor/templates changes.
